questions.question: What did Saul do wrong while waiting for Samuel?
options: He fled from the camp when the army scattered
He attacked the Philistines well before they were truly ready
He offered the burnt offering himself instead of waiting
He counted the fighting men against God's command
questions.answer: He offered the burnt offering himself instead of waiting

questions.question: What did Samuel tell Saul because of his disobedience?
options: His power would be greatly increased
His reign would go on unchanged

questions.question: Samuel said God had sought a man after his own heart to be king.
Saul disobeyed by offering the _____ offering himself instead of waiting for Samuel.
Samuel said the LORD had sought a man after his own _____.
